note: Hand-curated input of docs/ARCHITECTURE-MAP.md. Everything derivable (pins, workflows, triggers, justfile recipes, buncc commands) is read from the repository by factory/bunos/generate-map.ts; factory/bunos/consistency.ts fails when an entry points at something that does not exist. status: built = code present and unit-tested locally; ci-verified = the listed CI job passed on origin/os; unverified = not run, or CI red. pending = the owner announced it but it has not landed: the map lists it, and the check fails once the file exists while pending is still set.

ci.note: required = the status checks a merge into os waits for. Workflows that run Bun use the one setup action (setup-workspace -> setup-bun); workflows that build in a Linux container (container, arch-chroot) do not install Bun on the runner and are listed in noBunSetup.

noBunSetup.wsl-kernel.yml: builds the WSL kernel on an ubuntu runner with the distribution toolchain; no Bun step
noBunSetup.wsl-rootfs.yml: builds the rootfs inside an archlinux:base-devel container; Bun is bootstrapped inside the chroot by build-rootfs.sh
noBunSetup.rustbase.yml: jobs run in Arch and Ubuntu containers; the Bun step uses oven-sh/setup-bun directly (owner: rustbase, to move to the setup action)
noBunSetup.wasmos.yml: jobs install the pinned Bun with npm install -g bun@BUN_VERSION (same version source as setup-bun, no integrity check) and drive Chromium; owner: wasmos, to move to the setup action
noBunSetup.buncc-linux-desktop.yml: jobs install the pinned Bun with npm install -g bun@BUN_VERSION on ubuntu and windows runners and build in an Arch container; owner: linux-desktop, to move to the setup action
